$comment: Accepted npm advisories that have no patched release reachable from this project. Each entry must name the exact advisory, package and lockfile locations, give a specific reason and a review date. Expired or unused entries fail the scan.

exceptions.name: minimatch
exceptions.reason: Bundled inside aws-cdk-lib 2.276.0, the latest release, so npm overrides cannot replace it (the top-level minimatch is overridden to 11.0.8). aws-cdk-lib only matches glob patterns supplied by this repository's code or the CDK CLI operator (asset excludes, bundling-stack selection, construct selectors) during local synthesis; no untrusted input reaches it and it is never deployed to AWS. Remove when aws-cdk-lib bundles minimatch >= 11.0.1.
